Two bounded live calls through Cohere's OpenAI-compatibility endpoint (json_object-only, then full JSON Schema via response_format) both returned byte-identical malformed Cohere output (evidence_strength: 'unsupported'). Cohere is unsupported for the frozen panel under this access path. The implementation attempt is archived, not part of this branch's history.

The native Cohere ClientV2 transport had three authorized live confirmations rejected with 400 before producing any content, each naming a different field, before a fourth confirmation succeeded. Call 1 (unprojected schema): rejected, error capture truncated to HTTP headers only (fixed afterward: cohere_native._sanitized_error_message). Call 2 (schema projection v1, minimum/maximum removed): rejected again, fixed capture recovered the exact reason for the first time: '$id' schema-identity keyword unsupported. Call 3 (schema projection v2, $id additionally removed; request_hash be312ecf...): rejected a third time, on a new field: schema_version's 'const' declared without a required 'type' companion. Call 4 (schema projection v3, type: 'string' added to schema_version; request_hash f062ea28...): SUCCEEDED -- finish_reason COMPLETE, valid judgment generated and passed full canonical local validation. RESOLVED as of call 4; superseded by the positive result in validated_contributions.
